Paid gross."}],"notes":"Draft schedule for D-001 (Atlas Growth Fund I, record date 2026-10-30, payment date 2026-11-16), prepared 2026-10-06 up to step 9; not reviewed or signed. Withholding rates are in percent (15 = 15%).

TOTALS
- Gross 12,000,000.00, tax 1,510,562.50, net 10,489,437.50.
- D-001-A (US-source dividend from Orion): gross 10,000,000.00, tax 1,510,562.50, net 8,489,437.50.
- D-001-B (return of capital): gross 2,000,000.00, no tax.
- Gross reconciles to notice DOC-0201 and to the treasury lines, and the register interests at the record date sum to 100%.

DECISIONS FOR THE REVIEWER
1. I-006 Meridian Holdings I — I put this at the 30% default provisionally; this is the main judgement call.
   - Clearance CL-006 still reads cleared to 2027-12-31, but it relies on ownership fact DO-003, which ended 2026-07-31. Change case K-006 has been open since 2026-08-20 with no outcome.
   - After the restructuring (DOC-0106), Meridian I and Meridian II each hold 30% of the other. Resolving that loop, Meridian Family Trust (Jersey) is still the 100% ultimate owner, as before.
   - The trust (I-019) has no tax form or residence record on file. The LOB claim on F-006 is ownership / base erosion, so FR-07 (owner chain, non-mandatory) is relevant.
   - If K-006 closes before payment and confirms the claim, the line becomes 15%: tax 45,000 instead of 90,000, and total tax 1,465,562.50.
   - K-006 should be given the payment date as its deadline.
2. I-003 Kirchberg — 5% under R-03 rests on an effective vote in Orion of exactly 10.00% (12.5% of the fund x the fund's 80% of Orion).
   - I read the 10% minimum as "at least 10%".
   - If the test is "more than 10%", or the fund-level vote is not multiplied through, the rate is 15%: tax 187,500 instead of 62,500.
3. Defaults rather than holds — I could not confirm that the fund's terms allow a hold, because the LPA (DOC-0001) is not digitised. I-006, I-014 and I-015 are therefore at the default rate.

OTHER REDUCED RATES AND DEFAULTS
- 15% under R-02, Article 10: I-001, I-004, I-005, I-008, I-010, I-011, I-013.
  - I-004 misses the 5% rate narrowly: effective vote 9.99%.
  - I-005 holds 13% economic but 10% vote (class B), so effective vote is 8%.
  - I-001 and I-013 are pension funds. The rulebook has no pension-specific rate, so 15% is applied.
- I-015 Bertrange — 30% default. Its form ended 2025-12-31 and the clearance was withdrawn (K-015, no reply). A new W-8BEN-E is the item needed. Its interest rose from 3% to 5% on 2026-07-01, so 500,000 is exposed. No cure case is open; a renewed request with the payment date as deadline is possible.
- I-014 Client account 7731 — 30% default on 37.5% of the Sterling Nominees line. No certification is on file (MF-001); a W-8 or W-9 for the account holder is the item needed.
- Investor relations must notify the investors behind I-006, I-014 (via Sterling) and I-015 before payment (C3.7).

LOOK-THROUGH RECIPIENTS
The schedule lists the party whose income it is, so two payees are split across their owners. Treasury pays the payee:
- Atlas Lux Feeder (I-002, CP-102), split across I-010 50%, I-011 30%, I-012 20%: dividend gross 2,400,000, tax 432,000, net 1,968,000; return of capital 480,000.
- Sterling Nominees (I-007, CP-107), split across I-013 62.5% and I-014 37.5%: dividend gross 600,000, tax 123,750, net 476,250; return of capital 120,000.

DATA POINTS TO CHECK
- There are two investors named Alpha Holdings SA. I matched them by registration number and LEI: I-008 (Luxembourg, CP-108, 600,000, treaty 15%) and I-009 (Switzerland, CP-109, 100,000, no treaty claim, 30%). The payment file must not swap them.
- Atlas Co-Invest Vehicle (I-016) is 3% in the investor register and in the treasury lines, but 3.5% in entity management (H-006). I used 3%, since the register then sums to 100%.
- I-016 and I-017 are US partnerships on W-9, so the fund does not withhold. Any withholding on their own foreign partners is outside this schedule.
- The record date is still in the future. Holdings are taken from the register as it stands today and need re-checking on 2026-10-30.
- The dividend receipts from Orion to the SPV and from the SPV to the fund (P-007, P-008) are dated 2026-10-09 and 2026-10-12, so they have not yet settled.
- No distribution case, schedule or determination rows exist for D-001. My access is read-only, so the step 1 case and the schedule record still need to be created."}
